lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Glassy surface far above
I'm trading lungs for hollow love
The current drags my shadow down
Without a sound I start to drown
[chorus]
Drowning in the blue so deep
Promises I couldn't keep
Crushing weight upon my chest
Put my heavy heart to rest
[verse]
Pressure builds against the skin
Let the bitter salt rush in
A fragile cage of indigo
Nowhere left for me to go
[chorus]
Drowning in the blue so deep
Promises I couldn't keep
Crushing weight upon my chest
Put my heavy heart to rest
[bridge]
Furious tide, hold me under
Ripping the silence like thunder
Vulnerable, broken, and cold
Into the dark I unfold
[chorus]
Drowning in the blue so deep
Promises I couldn't keep
Crushing weight upon my chest
Put my heavy heart to rest
[outro]
